resources.string: Choose the LG TV or enter its address. Accept the connection request shown on the TV.
Approve CouchPilot on the LG TV.
No LG TV found. Enter its address manually.
Choose the Google TV box on your local network, then enter the code shown on the TV.
LG authorization needs to be refreshed. Tap Refresh LG authorization and approve the request on the TV.
Select your paired Samsung soundbar. It stays on optical D.IN. Close Samsung Audio Remote while using CouchPilot.
No paired Samsung soundbar is available. Check Bluetooth is on; your existing pairing can be reused.
The device is not connected. Open its setup to reconnect.
The device denied this action. Other controls may still work.
The device could not be reached. Check its connection and try again.
The device identity could not be verified. Open setup to review pairing.
This control is currently unavailable on the selected device.
The action could not be completed. Open device setup to reconnect.
Bluetooth controls Xiaomi directly when Wi-Fi cannot connect. Pair once; later openings reuse the connection.
While this remote is connected, Android may disconnect a Bluetooth keyboard or mouse connected to your phone.
This phone does not support Bluetooth remote control. Use Wi-Fi.

For first setup: on Xiaomi, open Settings → Remotes & accessories → Pair accessory. Then tap Pair Xiaomi below and approve any pairing prompts on the phone and TV. You do not need to find the phone in the TV list. After pairing, you can use other apps.
Bluetooth remote is unavailable. Check Bluetooth is on, or use Wi-Fi.
This phone is already paired. Reconnecting uses the saved pairing; new approval is normally unnecessary.
Soundbar power sends one toggle while connected. It does not guarantee wake from standby. After using it, automatic reconnection pauses; Retry resumes connection without sending another toggle.
Device connections stay active while you use other apps.
You can use other apps or lock your phone. The remote stays connected.
Remote connections are paused. Your devices remain on.
No wake address is saved for this TV. Connect while the TV is on to finish wake setup.
The device did not reconnect after the wake attempt. Its standby wake setting may need to be enabled.

Choose a source to switch to it. Power controls the device named below the title. Sound always controls Samsung. Xiaomi controls appear when Xiaomi is selected. Device management contains setup and help. You can use other apps while the remote stays connected.
For wake, save the TV MAC address and enable Turn on via Wi-Fi on the TV. Your connection is retained.
No saved Xiaomi pairing was found. For first Bluetooth setup, enter its Bluetooth address from the TV device information; then approve pairing. Wi-Fi setup is also available.
